explanation: All three integrands and their t derivatives are continuous on local rectangles within their stated domains. The derivatives are −t/(x²+t²)^(3/2), −x sin(xt), and −x⁵/(1+tx²)². For I, t>0 prevents a zero denominator; for III, t>−1 ensures 1+tx²>0 on [0,1]. Thus differentiation under the integral sign is valid for all three.
